messages.text: Where is my order? email (email hidden)

Trent, nothing has shipped yet. There's no change since Thursday.

Your B30 and its free Power K. (Shop····) still ship November 15, 2026. You can follow that batch on its way to us at https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Your Magic M. 40T (Shop····) has no tracking yet. Magic M. expected the units to leave the factory on November 12. I don't have a date for when yours ships on to you, but the tracking comes to this email as soon as it does.

Anything else I can check for you?
Will be b30 be shipped on the 15th ?

November 15 is still the ship date on your order, Trent. I can't promise it leaves on that exact day, though. The 15th falls on a Sunday, and your free Power K. is still waiting for stock to reach the warehouse.

As soon as your B30 ships, the tracking comes to this email. If the date moves, we'll tell you here or by email.

You can follow the batch's progress at https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status
